Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 10568/2024  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 14-05-2024  in CRM No. 7869/2024 passed by the High Court of Judicature at  Patna)
 DILIP MANDAL @ DILIP KUMAR Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS  STATE OF BIHAR & ANR.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at  Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(FOR ADMISSION and IA No.172291/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 12-08-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.K. MAHESHWARI  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH BINDAL  For Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Manohar Pratap, AOR  Ms. Bhavana Bisht, Adv.

UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Issue notice, returnable in six weeks.
Till the next date of listing, by way of interim relief, it is directed that subject to cooperation by the petitioner in the investigation, no coercive steps shall be taken against him in connection with FIR No.206/2023 dated 04.08.2023 registered at Police Station Amdabad, Mnihari, Katihar, for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
 (NIDHI AHUJA) (ANU BHALLA)
